name: named-subagents-mod
description: Gives every subagent a themed name in the task tree, and lists the running agents under those names in a side pane: what each is doing, its tokens, its conversation a press away.

theme.title: Name pool
theme.description: auto picks the pool from the agent type and task; any other value always uses that pool.

names.title: Your names
names.description: Extra names for your agents, separated by commas: Ripley, Deckard. They get about half of the draws. Letters, digits, _ and - only. /names adds more later.

only_custom.title: Use only my names
only_custom.description: Leave out the built-in names and draw only from the ones you add.

autoOpen.title: Pane: open by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the agents pane when an agent starts. Off, /agentpane opens it.

foldAfter.title: Pane: fold after (seconds)
foldAfter.description: Fold the pane this many seconds after the last agent finishes; 0 keeps it open.

motion.title: Pane: motion
motion.description: Animate the spinner on running agents.

keepFinished.title: Pane: finished agents listed
keepFinished.description: How many finished agents the list keeps (1-30).

statusLine.title: Pane: status line
statusLine.description: Count the running agents under the prompt while the pane is not on screen.
